items.title: Michael Max Fleming interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: you know Charles Mingus’ got a bad reputation

ctx.x: So you know what he said to me? “You ain’t shit.” Now my uncle was also a street person and those are fighting words partner. So now thinking of my uncle, I’m saying, “Hmmm. I’ve got a rough customer here.” So according to my uncle, if you’re going to jump on somebody like that you orchestrate it, first you’re going to do just like a football.

That’s where he learned it from. First you snap the ball, then you make an end run, and then you fake. So which way am I going to whip this old man? So the voice came in my mind says, “Don’t do that, Michael because you know Charles Mingus’ got a bad reputation and you just got in town. Don’t you start a fight, you’ll never get work.” So whatever happened? I don’t remember what tune we played but we played something else and then I walked across the floor to Mary Lou Williams, who was sitting there. And she’s…
